final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and to meet the docstring specifications:

- In bookings/billing.py, I changed billable_blocks to raise ValueError for negative minutes and to always round up partial blocks instead of using round().
- In bookings/timeutil.py, I fixed parse_duration to support all the documented formats (e.g., "1h30m", "2h", "45m", "1:30", "45") and to raise ValueError only if none match.
- In bookings/schedule.py, I fixed add_slot to avoid using a mutable default argument. It now uses None and creates a new list each call, so separate calls do not share state.

After these fixes, all tests pass when run with the correct PYTHONPATH.
